def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    c=max((v,n) for v,n in cnt.items() if v!=0)[0]
    div_rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==c for x in g[r])]
    div_cols=[cc for cc in range(W) if all(g[r][cc]==c for r in range(H))]
    bands=[]; start=0
    for r in sorted(div_rows)+[H]:
        if r>start: bands.append((start,r)); start=r+1
    blocks=[]; start=0
    for cc in sorted(div_cols)+[W]:
        if cc>start: blocks.append((start,cc)); start=cc+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r0,r1) in bands:
        for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(blocks):
            pix=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1) for cc in range(a,b) if g[r][cc]!=0 and g[r][cc]!=c]
            if not pix: continue
            left_empty = bi==0 or all(g[r][cc]==0 for r in range(r0,r1) for cc in range(*blocks[bi-1]))
            if bi+1<len(blocks) and left_empty:
                a2,b2=blocks[bi+1]
                if all(g[r][cc]==0 for r in range(r0,r1) for cc in range(a2,b2)):
                    w=b-a
                    for (r,cc) in pix:
                        out[r][a2+(w-1-(cc-a))]=g[r][cc]
    return out
